name: pdfmonkey
label: PDFMonkey
description: Generate PDF documents from templates and JSON data.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your PDFMonkey secret API key. In PDFMonkey, open [My Account](https://dashboard.pdfmonkey.io/account) and copy the API Secret Key.

get_document_ai.label: Get Document (AI)
get_document_ai.description: Get a document's status, file name and download link by its ID.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.

update_document.label: Update Document
update_document.description: Change a document's data, metadata, file name or template, and optionally generate it again.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: Switch the document to another template. Leave empty to keep the current one.

payload.label: Payload
payload.description: New data for the document, as a JSON object. Replaces the whole payload. Leave empty to keep it.

meta.label: Meta
meta.description: New metadata, as a JSON object. Replaces all meta keys. Leave empty to keep it.

file_name.label: Custom File Name
file_name.description: Name of the generated file, e.g. "Invoice 2026-001.pdf". Stored as the _filename meta key.

generate.label: Generate Now
generate.description: Queue the document for generation after the update (sets its status to pending).

download_document.label: Download Document
download_document.description: Download a generated document as a file you can attach or upload in later steps.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The document ID (a UUID), e.g. from Generate Document or List Documents.

file_name.label: File Name
file_name.description: Name for the downloaded file. Defaults to the document file name.

get_template.label: Get Template
get_template.description: Get a template with its HTML, test data and page settings.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: The template ID (a UUID). Use List Templates to find it.

get_current_user.label: Get Account Info
get_current_user.description: Get the connected PDFMonkey account, its plan and how many documents it can still generate.
